title: HL7-PET Escape-Sequence Decoding Conformance Vector
description: Schema for a single escape-sequence-decoding conformance vector, as defined by spec 1001-escape-sequence-decoding. Distinct vector family from spec 001's path-*/spec 002's hier-*/spec 005's scan-* vectors (spec 003 FR-007 extensibility) since it exercises decode_escapes()'s output rather than pure PATH evaluation or scanning. Kept separate from fixtures/vectors/path/ deliberately: no message in that pre-existing corpus contains an escape sequence, and mixing them in would blur which vectors exist specifically to validate decoding. Consumed by fixtures/scripts/validate_corpus.py and crates/core/tests/escape_vectors.rs.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this vector within the whole suite, e.g. "escape-field-sep".

path.description: The PATH expression under test, exactly as a caller would pass it (e.g. "PID-5").

message_ref.description: Relative path (from fixtures/) to the synthetic source HL7 message file this vector is evaluated against. MUST point to a message satisfying spec 001 FR-009 (no real patient data).

method.description: Which extraction method/variant this vector exercises.

expected.description: Expected DECODED result. For getValue: a two-dimensional array (outer = segment occurrences, inner = field repetitions). For getFirstValue: a single string, or null if no match.

escape_types.description: Which documented escape-sequence type(s) this vector exercises (drives coverage tracking, mirroring spec 001's grammar_productions and spec 002's semantic_rules). H\ and N\ are tracked as one combined type since they only ever appear as a pair.
